Bug_Title: Double Brace Initialization should not be used
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by using Double Brace Initialization to create a HashMap. This practice is discouraged because it creates an anonymous class with a reference to the instance of the owning object, which can lead to memory leaks and confusion.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the showBug method of DoubleBraceInitializationExample, which uses Double Brace Initialization to populate the map.
